title: [DOC-12] Discord browser key generation does not follow the spec §12.6 non-PRF path
description: Review finding DOC-12: Discord browser key generation does not follow the spec §12.6 non-PRF path (lens DOC). Location: profiles/discord-onboarding.md:139-140, :170; spec/12-security.md:82-85. Fix: As proposed. The key is generated `extractable: true` at :140 before PRF support is known, but the non-PRF path at :170 stores "a non-extractable device key". An extractable CryptoKey cannot be made non-extractable. Reorder so the passkey is created and PRF tested first, then generate with `true` (PRF) or `false` (no PRF). The genesis signing at :136-137 must follow that step. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: profiles/discord-onboarding.md browser key section (~:138-173): passkey created and PRF tested first, then `generateKey(..., prfSupported, ...)` (non-extractable on no-PRF path), genesis signing after
